tasks.assumptions: Fictional Ontario Class 3 water treatment plant log. Steady flow unless noted. Archived plant, laboratory, and maintenance records are available for review.

Filter shortening is unrelated to the product
Purchase price decides total cost

inference.explanation: Matched water and equal settling isolate the product difference to what settling does not show, residual organics and filter loading. Full cost accounting reverses the purchase price conclusion.

tasks.assumptions: Fictional Ontario Class 3 water treatment plant log. Steady flow unless noted. Archived plant, laboratory, and maintenance records are available for review.

evidence.label: Settled turbidity rises from 1.2 to 1.9 NTU in the dose trial.

Chemical savings always reduce total cost
Filter and membrane effects are unrelated to settled turbidity
Quality compliance proves the cut is good economics

inference.explanation: Compliance holds, so the question is economics. Shorter filter runs, more backwash, and faster membrane fouling all track the higher settled turbidity, and total cost rises even as chemical spend falls.
